name: aws-rag-mcp
description: Search and navigate a multi-scale RAG database of electronics datasheets and reference manuals.
long_description: Exposes a local SQLite-backed RAG store as MCP tools. Supports hybrid (BM25 + dense vector) search, hierarchical chunk navigation, figure retrieval, and document metadata lookup. Embeddings are computed via AWS Bedrock (Titan v2). Designed for scoped, per-project usage from Claude Code.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Hybrid (BM25 + dense vector), keyword-only, or vector-only search over RAG chunks

tools.name: get_chunk
tools.description: Fetch a single chunk by ID, optionally including its neighbours

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Step through the chunk graph: parent, children, prev, next, or chapter_root

tools.name: zoom_in
tools.description: Get finer-grained child chunks (macro → meso, meso → micro)

tools.name: zoom_out
tools.description: Get the parent chunk for broader context (micro → meso, meso → macro)

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List documents in the current project, optionally filtered by group/MPN/manufacturer

tools.name: get_document_metadata
tools.description: Fetch the metadata sidecar for a document (MPN, manufacturer, tags, subsystem)

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Return chunk counts (total and by level) for the current scope

tools.name: get_figure
tools.description: Fetch the image for a figure chunk and return it for the user to see

tools.name: show_pdf
tools.description: Open the source PDF for a document in an interactive scrollable viewer (Claude Desktop)

db_path.title: SQLite Database Path
db_path.description: Path to the RAG SQLite database file (output/rag.sqlite in your project directory).

s3_bucket.title: S3 Bucket
s3_bucket.description: S3 bucket name used for PDF storage and Textract output (RAG_S3_BUCKET).

aws_region.title: AWS Region
aws_region.description: AWS region for Bedrock and S3 (e.g. eu-west-1).

default_project_id.title: Default Project ID
default_project_id.description: Scope all tool calls to this project by default. Leave blank to search globally.

figures_dir.title: Figures Directory
figures_dir.description: Directory holding cropped figure PNGs. Used to serve images over a loopback HTTP server so Claude Desktop can render them inline (file:// is blocked by the renderer). Leave blank to use <db_path parent>/figures.
